title: Receiver entered protection mode
shortDescription: Denon AVR shut down into PROTECT mode due to shorted speaker, overload, or internal fault.
fullDescription:
Denon AVR-X series (X2700H, X3700H, X4700H, etc.) enter PROTECT mode when the amplifier section detects a fault - most commonly a shorted speaker wire (stray strands touching) or a blown HDAM output stage. The display briefly shows PROTECT and the unit shuts off.

Never repeatedly power the unit back on if PROTECT recurs - that risks further damage. Disconnect all speakers first and test without load.

causes.cause: Blown speaker with shorted voice coil

fixSteps.title: Disconnect all speaker wires
fixSteps.instruction: Remove every speaker connection from the back of the receiver.

fixSteps.title: Power on with no speakers
fixSteps.instruction: If PROTECT still triggers, fault is internal.

fixSteps.title: Inspect speaker wire ends
fixSteps.instruction: Look for stray strands touching between + and -. Re-trim and twist each end cleanly.

fixSteps.title: Reconnect one speaker at a time
fixSteps.instruction: Identify the channel that triggers PROTECT to isolate the short.

fixSteps.title: Service if internal
fixSteps.instruction: PROTECT with no load means internal failure - send to Denon service.

whenToCallPro: PROTECT triggers with no speakers connected - internal amp failure.

faq.a: A high transient pushed a marginal speaker connection into a short.

faq.q: Will HDAM repair be covered by warranty?

title: Thermal shutdown due to overheating
shortDescription: Heatsink temperature exceeded safe limit and receiver shut down.
fullDescription: Denon AVRs dissipate significant heat, especially when driving 4-ohm speakers or in Direct/Pure mode. If placed in a tight cabinet without airflow, internal temperature rises until the thermal cutoff triggers.
symptoms: Shuts off after 30-60 min of loud use

fixSteps.title: Improve airflow
fixSteps.instruction: Leave 6 inches above and behind. Open cabinet doors or add cooling fan.

fixSteps.title: Vacuum vents
fixSteps.instruction: Remove dust with soft brush and vacuum on low.

fixSteps.title: Check speaker impedance
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm speakers are 6-ohm minimum; set impedance switch if applicable.

whenToCallPro: Internal fan failed on a model that has one.

faq.q: Is it ok to stack components on top?
faq.a: No - blocks top vents and causes overheating.

title: HDMI handshake / HDCP error
shortDescription: Video flickers to black or never appears due to HDMI/HDCP negotiation failure.
fullDescription:
Denon AVR-X3700H and similar 8K-capable models have been widely documented with HDMI 2.1 handshake issues - especially with Xbox Series X at 4K/120Hz VRR or when chained to a TV that renegotiates HDCP. Symptoms include intermittent black screens, snow, or audio without video.

Denon released firmware and hardware chipset swap programs for the HDMI 2.1 bug on 2020 models.

fixSteps.title: Swap HDMI cable
fixSteps.instruction: Use certified Ultra High Speed HDMI (48 Gbps) cable under 3m.

fixSteps.title: Update firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Menu > General > Firmware > Check for Update.

fixSteps.title: Set source output to 4K60 Test
fixSteps.instruction: Temporarily drop Xbox/PS5 to 4K60 to isolate the 2.1 bug.

fixSteps.title: Denon HDMI hardware fix
fixSteps.instruction: Eligible AVR-X3700H/4700H/6700H owners can request the 8K chipset swap or adapter.

whenToCallPro: For the HDMI 2.1 hardware fix program.

faq.q: Is the HDMI bug fixed in new models?
faq.a: Yes - 2021+ Denon models have corrected HDMI 2.1 chipsets.

title: Firmware update failed mid-install
shortDescription: Network drop or power loss interrupted firmware; unit may be bricked or stuck in update loop.
fullDescription: Interrupting a Denon firmware update can leave the unit in update loop. Never power cycle mid-update. If it occurs, leave plugged in for 30 minutes - the recovery partition often self-heals.

fixSteps.title: Wait 30 minutes plugged in
fixSteps.instruction: Let the unit attempt recovery - do not unplug.

fixSteps.title: Unplug for 5 minutes
fixSteps.instruction: After waiting, unplug fully and retry.

fixSteps.title: Denon service
fixSteps.instruction: If still bricked, send to authorized service center.

whenToCallPro: Wired Ethernet update still fails - service required.
videoSearchQuery: Denon AVR firmware update failed recovery

faq.q: Use WiFi or Ethernet for updates?
faq.a: Always wired Ethernet - drastically more reliable.

title: Audyssey calibration failed
shortDescription: Calibration cannot complete - mic, speaker, or noise issue.
fullDescription: Audyssey MultEQ fails when it cannot hear test tones clearly - mic unplugged, bad mic cable, wrong speaker wiring, or background noise. The receiver reports 'Check mic' or aborts after one position.

fixSteps.title: Reseat mic cable
fixSteps.instruction: Remove and firmly reinsert the Audyssey mic in the Setup Mic jack.

fixSteps.title: Turn off HVAC and noisy appliances
fixSteps.instruction: Run calibration in a quiet room.

fixSteps.title: Check speaker polarity
fixSteps.instruction: Swapped + and - leads cause Audyssey to fail polarity check.

fixSteps.title: Power on sub
fixSteps.instruction: Confirm subwoofer is on and RCA cable seated.

whenToCallPro: Only if mic is confirmed damaged - order new from Denon.

faq.q: Can I run calibration with speakers not yet placed?
faq.a: No - calibrate after all speakers are in final position.

title: Video passes but no audio
shortDescription: Picture shows but speakers silent; often input source or bitstream issue.
fullDescription: Common when source (PS5, Apple TV) outputs Dolby Atmos/TrueHD that is incompatible with current AVR setup, or when the AVR's input mode is set to HDMI/Analog only.

fixSteps.title: Check mute
fixSteps.instruction: Press mute on remote - obvious but common.

fixSteps.title: Set source to PCM
fixSteps.instruction: In PS5/Apple TV audio settings, change bitstream to PCM temporarily.

faq.a: Yes - Ultra High Speed HDMI cable for full eARC.

title: DC offset detected on output
shortDescription: Receiver shut down because DC voltage was detected on a speaker output.
fullDescription: When an amp channel's output transistor partially shorts, DC voltage appears at the speaker terminals. The protection circuit cuts output to prevent voice coil damage. Immediate service needed.

fixSteps.title: Service center
fixSteps.instruction: Denon-authorized service for amp board repair.

whenToCallPro: Always - DC offset is a hardware failure.

faq.a: Yes - sustained DC burns voice coils quickly.

title: HEOS service offline
shortDescription: Receiver disconnected from HEOS cloud; streaming services unavailable.
fullDescription: HEOS powers Denon's streaming features. When offline, Spotify Connect, Amazon Music, and internet radio stop. Often caused by network changes, IPv6 issues, or HEOS server outages.

fixSteps.title: Reboot router and AVR
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug router first, then AVR, wait 1 min, reboot both.

fixSteps.title: Re-add to HEOS app
fixSteps.instruction: Remove device in HEOS app and re-add.

fixSteps.title: Use Ethernet
fixSteps.instruction: Wired connection is far more stable for HEOS.

whenToCallPro: HEOS cloud outage - wait for Denon resolution.

faq.a: Often yes - AirPlay bypasses HEOS cloud.

title: Zone 2 has no audio
shortDescription: Zone 2 output silent despite source playing.
fullDescription: Zone 2 on Denon AVRs can only play analog or stereo PCM sources - HDMI bitstream and Dolby Atmos do not output to Zone 2. Users commonly hit this trying to send Netflix to a second room.

fixSteps.title: Set source output to PCM
fixSteps.instruction: On Apple TV or similar, change audio output to stereo PCM.

faq.q: Why can't Zone 2 play Dolby Atmos?
faq.a: Zone 2 is a stereo zone - only 2-channel PCM can be decoded.

title: eARC audio drops intermittently
shortDescription: Audio cuts out for 1-2 seconds every few minutes during TV apps.
fullDescription: A well-known issue on Denon AVRs with LG and Samsung OLEDs - eARC renegotiates and drops audio briefly. Often improved with firmware and higher quality HDMI cables.

fixSteps.title: Update both AVR and TV
fixSteps.instruction: Install latest firmware on both ends.

fixSteps.title: Use certified eARC HDMI cable
fixSteps.instruction: Ultra High Speed HDMI certified cable, <3m.

fixSteps.title: Disable TV HDMI deep color/game mode briefly
fixSteps.instruction: Test if specific TV features trigger dropout.

videoSearchQuery: Denon eARC audio dropout LG OLED

faq.a: Yes - supports Atmos TrueHD and DTS-HD lossless.

title: Check speaker wire warning
shortDescription: Startup self-test detected a short or no load on a speaker output.
fullDescription: Denon performs a speaker impedance check on power-on. If any channel sees a short or abnormal load, it reports CHECK SP WIRE on the display and refuses to enable that channel.

fixSteps.title: Re-trim speaker ends
fixSteps.instruction: Cut cleanly and twist strands tight with no whiskers.

faq.a: Yes if impedance switch is set to 4 ohm, but expect more heat.

title: Remote control unresponsive
shortDescription: AVR does not respond to remote commands.
fullDescription: Usually dead batteries or a blocked IR receiver. Can also be that the remote is set to a different zone or the unit is in a mode that ignores IR briefly (e.g., booting).

fixSteps.title: Press MAIN button
fixSteps.instruction: Ensure remote is commanding Main zone not Zone 2.

fixSteps.title: Clean IR window
fixSteps.instruction: Wipe front panel IR sensor with microfiber.

fixSteps.title: Test with phone camera
fixSteps.instruction: Point remote at phone camera - should see IR LED flash.

faq.q: Can I use the HEOS app?
faq.a: Yes - full remote functionality via HEOS or AVR Remote app.

title: Protection Circuit Engaged
shortDescription: AVR shut down to protect itself.
fullDescription: Denon receiver enters PROTECT mode shutting down outputs due to detected fault.

fixSteps.title: Disconnect speakers
fixSteps.instruction: Remove all speaker wires, power on - if no PROTECT, a wire shorts.

fixSteps.title: Cool down
fixSteps.instruction: Allow 30 minutes with vents clear before retry.

whenToCallPro: If PROTECT persists with no speakers connected.

faq.a: Stray speaker wire strand shorting between + and -.

title: HDMI Copy Protection Fail
fullDescription: HDCP error means the AVR could not negotiate copy protection between source and TV.

fixSteps.title: Reseat HDMI
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug and replug HDMI cables on both ends.

fixSteps.title: Use Premium HDMI
fixSteps.instruction: Replace with certified Premium High Speed HDMI cable.

faq.a: Yes for 4K HDR sources like UHD Blu-ray.

title: Cloud Login Failed
fullDescription: HEOS account login fails on the AVR - password, captcha, or cloud outage.

fixSteps.title: Re-login
fixSteps.instruction: Settings > HEOS Account > sign out and back in.

fixSteps.title: Reset password
fixSteps.instruction: Use HEOS app to reset account password.

faq.a: Yes - HDMI/optical sources work without HEOS.

title: Mic or Position Issue
fullDescription: Audyssey MultEQ calibration fails - microphone, noise, or speaker connection issue.

fixSteps.title: Reseat mic
fixSteps.instruction: Plug mic firmly into front mic jack.

fixSteps.title: Quiet room
fixSteps.instruction: Eliminate AC, fans, talking during sweep.

faq.a: Yes but room correction quality drops significantly.

title: eARC Handshake Issue
shortDescription: AVR not engaging eARC with TV.
fullDescription: eARC connection to TV not engaging - falls back to ARC or fails entirely.

fixSteps.title: Use Ultra HS HDMI
fixSteps.instruction: Use 48Gbps certified Ultra High Speed HDMI.

fixSteps.title: Enable eARC on TV
fixSteps.instruction: TV settings > Audio Output > set to eARC.

faq.a: Usually HDMI Out Monitor labeled eARC.

title: 8K Pass-through Bug
fullDescription: Older Denon 8K firmware has known 4K/120 and 8K passthrough bug requiring fix or update.

fixSteps.title: Update firmware
fixSteps.instruction: Install latest firmware which includes 8K hotfix.

fixSteps.title: HDMI 2.1 cable
fixSteps.instruction: Use 48Gbps Ultra High Speed HDMI between source/AVR/TV.

faq.a: Denon offered hardware adapter for affected 2020 units.

title: Zone 2 Configuration
shortDescription: Second zone has no audio output.
fullDescription: Zone 2 outputs no sound despite source playing - assignment or amp config issue.

fixSteps.title: Assign source
fixSteps.instruction: Zone 2 menu - select valid source (analog or HEOS).

fixSteps.title: Amp Assign
fixSteps.instruction: Setup > Amp Assign > set to enable Zone 2 amps.

faq.a: Only on flagships supporting HDMI Zone 2.
